# Esti Smit Biokinetics

> HPCSA-registered biokinetics practice in Paarl, Western Cape, South Africa. Esti Smit, Zani Van Zyl and Anya Bruwer provide personalised exercise therapy for pain, injury, post-operative rehabilitation, chronic conditions, sports performance and healthy ageing. Medical aid friendly.

Biokinetics is exercise therapy. It is the last stage of the recovery chain, between clinical treatment (such as physiotherapy or surgery) and everyday life. A biokineticist assesses how you move, finds the weak or switched-off muscles behind the pain, and builds a personalised exercise programme to restore strength and movement. No referral is needed to book.

## Programmes

- Move Beyond Pain: ongoing pain that stops you enjoying life (back, neck, hip, shoulder, knee, ankle pain, arthritis, sciatica, tendinopathies, repetitive strain injuries).
- Recover Stronger: safe recovery after surgery or injury (ACL rehab, shoulder surgery, hip and knee replacements, fractures, sports injuries, tendon repairs).
- Move Better: improve mobility, posture and strength before injuries start.
- Perform Better: performance and injury prevention for golfers, runners, cyclists, padel, CrossFit, HYROX and active adults.
- Healthy Living: guided exercise for diabetes, high blood pressure, obesity, high cholesterol, metabolic syndrome, cancer and cardiac rehabilitation.
- Stay Active for Life: independence, strength and balance as you age (over 50s and 60s, osteoporosis, fall prevention).

## Conditions and areas treated

Knee, hip, neck and shoulder, low back, foot and ankle, elbow and wrist pain and injuries; balance, posture and healthy ageing; disabilities and neurological conditions (stroke recovery, cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury); athletes and sports performance; chronic conditions.

## Medical aid

- In most cases, biokinetics sessions are paid from your medical savings account. Some schemes and benefit options give additional cover. Coverage depends on your plan and available benefits.
- Discovery Vitality: Health Check (up to 22,500 Vitality points) and Fitness Assessment (R580, up to 10,000 additional points).
- Momentum Multiply: Health Assessment and Fitness Assessment (R480).
- Medscheme weight management programme for members of participating schemes such as Polmed, Fedhealth, AECI Medical Aid Society and SAMWUMED.
